note.ja: 流入・除去を持つ自己触媒反応拡散。斑点分裂の画像だけで細胞分裂や線形Turing不安定性とは判定しません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A chemical feed/decay model whose spatial extension supports diverse spot and wave patterns. 1983 is the well-mixed CSTR source; Pearson 1993 is the spatial pattern reference. Spot division does not by itself demonstrate cell division or a linear Turing instability. Literature-only.
